newsitem.title: USA: Finova Group to join S&P MidCap 400 Index.
newsitem.headline: Finova Group to join S&P MidCap 400 Index.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services said on Thursday it will add Finova Group Inc to its MidCap 400 Index after the close of trading on July 7, replacing Dauphin Deposit Corp.
Dauphin Deposit Corp is being acquired by Allied Irish Banks Plc in a merger expected to close on the same date, S&P said in a statement.
The Finova Group, headquartered in Phoenix, is a commercial finance company providing services to midsize businesses.
Standard & Poor's calculates and maintains the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, and the S&P Super Composite 1500 stock price indexes, which are barometers of stock market activity.
